proof_body:
by
  intro m _ _ A x₀ t
  letI : NormedRing (Matrix m m ℝ) := Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing
  letI : NormedAlgebra ℝ (Matrix m m ℝ) := Matrix.linftyOpNormedAlgebra
  have h := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' (𝕂 := ℝ) A t
  let L : Matrix m m ℝ →L[ℝ] (m → ℝ) :=
    { toFun := fun M => M.mulVec x₀
      map_add' := fun M N => Matrix.add_mulVec M N x₀
      map_smul' := fun c M => Matrix.smul_mulVec c M x₀
      cont := continuous_id.matrix_mulVec continuous_const }
  have h2 := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  exact h2
target_source: ∀ (m : Type*) [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m m ℝ) (x₀ : m → ℝ) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)).mulVec x₀) (A.mulVec ((NormedSpace.exp (t • A)).mulVec x₀)) t
